blocks.html: Build and send a structured report from ATAK so your HQ gets the picture in a known format, saved locally or pushed straight to the TAK Server.

slides.title: Open the Reports tool
slides.html:
Tap Reports in the toolbar.

  • The Reports panel opens with Search, Multi-select, Sort, Create A Report, Editor, Visibility and Delete All.
  • You do not need a TAK Server connection to create one.

slides.title: Start a new report
slides.html: Tap Create A Report. The Report Category prompt appears. Pick the report type that fits, for example Counter Intel, DHS, Surveillance or Custom.

slides.title: Fill in the fields
slides.html: Work down the form and complete each field. Required fields show in red text until filled. Add a Title, check the DateTime, and use Tags to make the report easy to find later.

slides.title: Set the location
slides.html: Use the pencil icon on the Location row to set or edit the report position, then add a Location Description if it helps. The grid reference is filled in automatically.

slides.title: Add attachments
slides.html: Tap + Add New Attachment to attach a photo, video or file from the device. Tap the Delete icon next to any item to remove it.

slides.title: Save, upload or send
slides.html: When finished, tap Save & Close to keep a local copy, or Upload to publish to the TAK Server. The Send dialog can also push the report to a Contact, Cloud/FTP, another app, or Export it.
